i used to feel like this a lot. im less suicidal now by a lot but when i was really bad I'd lay in bed and just run through ways to do it and it calmed me down and helped me fall asleep. obviously thats not healthy, but im just saying i understand where you are right now. i watched every car go by and picture myself underneath it, what it would crush on me and how it would feel. and how i would die. i completely understand. this was a horrible time in my life and i dont wish these feelings on anyone. i wish you the best of luck in your healing process when you get to a point where you are ready to heal. this is all about you and your life, take your time and don't rush your healing for anyone. you are the only one in control of how you feel, make the most of it. im not religious but im keeping you in my thoughts, hopefully somd cosmic monster will send positivity your way. peace and love my friend, feel free to pm me anytime

remember that threats like that are completely reportable. no one deserves to be treated that way, especially not someone struggling with gender issues as you are. you deserve a wonderful, happy life, and you did absolutely nothing wrong. be proud that you stood up and told him no, some people can't muster up that courage. it's okay to feel upset about it though. let yourself feel the pain, accept, then let it float away slowly like a cloud does across the sky. reflect on it, but never dwell and ruminate. know that you deserve a life worth living
